name: migration-preview
title: Migration Preview
description: Stops migrations that take production down or lose data by reading Postgres SQL back step by step (strings, dollar quotes and comments handled), showing what each step locks and whether it touches every row of a big table, marking dropped tables and columns as impossible to undo, and catching NOT NULL columns that will fail, renames that break code mid-deploy, CONCURRENTLY inside a transaction and a missing lock_timeout, with a one-tap safer sequence and undo.

meta.stops: Migration locks production table for hours
